text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Reunion, The Algorithm, The Influencer. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Elena follows Miguel in — The Reunion still stands.
🛡️ a woman, maybe 30s follows Emma in — The Algorithm still stands.
🛡️ Three dawns The Influencer has held the treeline. a woman, maybe 30s takes the shield wall out — no more waiting.
🛡️ The watch looks at The Influencer on the treeline — three dawns now — and looks away. Nobody fit to face it today.
